sources.label: SneakerPing homepage (verified 2026-09-12)
sources.claim: SneakerPing is a sneaker price-alert service: it watches StockX, GOAT, eBay, and 40+ online stores and pings the buyer when a tracked pair drops to their target price, with SMS, email, and Discord notifications, a 7-to-365-day price outlook, a free tier that watches 5 pairs with no credit card, and paid plans behind a 7-day free trial.
